about_the_game:
Become the hero of the local art scene in The Art Collector! Assume the role of an artist and dedicated friend, entrusted with preserving the community's art gallery. Your mentor, the venerable curator of the gallery, relies on your expertise to ensure its survival in the face of mounting challenges.

Key Features:

Curate Your Destiny: Immerse yourself in the exhilarating world of art curation. Buy, sell, and master the art of negotiation to keep the gallery's doors open and the bills paid.

Personalized Spaces: Showcase your unique style by customizing both your gallery and home.

Artistic Expression: Unleash your creativity by crafting and selling your own masterpieces. Explore various mediums and styles to leave your mark on the art world.

Empower Local Talent: Forge meaningful connections with up-and-coming artists. Champion their work, provide exposure, and watch as they blossom into the stars of tomorrow.

Experience the Thrill of the Art World: Learn the intricate dance of supply and demand, where every sale and acquisition shapes the destiny of the gallery. Make strategic decisions, cultivate relationships, and navigate the ever-changing art market to ensure your success.

Join the Journey:

Become a part of our passionate community of art enthusiasts and aspiring creators by joining our discord. Stay tuned for exciting updates, community events, and ongoing support as we continue to develop "The Art Collector"

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-2100 / AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 Ti / AMD Radeon HD 7850
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible sound card
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4460 / AMD Ryzen 5 1600
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 970 / AMD Radeon RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible sound card

short_description: You're an artist tasked with taking over an art gallery in order to help your mentor. Customize your gallery and home, befriend local artists while you get them the exposure they need, and master the fine art of selling fine art in this Roguelite, Shopkeeper, Capitalism-Management, Sim.
